description: Translate HLA allele names from one IPD-IMGT/HLA release to another, through each allele's HLA ID, using the official Allelelist_history.txt (every release since 1.05.0). Give the names as they were written in release `from` (omit `from` to accept a name used in any release); `to` defaults to the current release. Each row says unchanged, renamed (to_name), deleted (reason, successor and its name in `to`), not_yet_named, not_in_from_release, ambiguous (each allele listed) or unknown. Use it when data typed under an older release has to be compared with or reported under a newer one. Lab shorthand (B*1501, A*02:XX) belongs in normalize_allele first. Allele strings only, no patient identifiers.

from.description: An IPD-IMGT/HLA release, like "3.40.0" (1.05.0 to the current one).

names.description: Allele names exactly as written in the `from` release.

to.description: An IPD-IMGT/HLA release, like "3.40.0" (1.05.0 to the current one).

name: translate_names
